status: application integration gates; not the prototype unit test results
live_reads: only explicitly selected existing resources through fixed bridge; no automated broad crawler

checks.name: Source and phase
checks.experiment: Record base/current head, dirty source digest, bridge policy, app/build/browser versions. Keep repository source separate from deployed response metadata.
checks.pass_condition: No claim of deployment or provider quality.

checks.name: Read-only bridge
checks.experiment: Offline bridge tests attempt every operational POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE including quote, claim, source, plan, runs and delete. Count upstream fetches.
checks.pass_condition: Zero operational upstream requests; original non-review bridge tests retained.

checks.name: Live response fidelity
checks.experiment: With offline known response bytes, test permitted passthrough and bounded opt-in capture. With an existing owner-authorized call, use only necessary real GETs.
checks.pass_condition: Bodies/status unchanged; no /v1 replay replacement; unknown method/path denied.

checks.name: Restore entry
checks.experiment: Budget-neutral browser regression delays workspace/session/submission/report reads separately, direct ready call URL, fresh URL and invalid call URL. Inspect initial export and frame transitions.
checks.pass_condition: Neutral until intent/ownership known; direct validated report; no upload/onboarding/preparation flash on existing ready call; no writes.

checks.name: URL and history
checks.experiment: Open Calls -> call -> section -> source point; Back/reload/invalid section; injected state/approval params.
checks.pass_condition: Call navigation pushes; section replaces without remount; no background stage history; query never changes authority.

checks.name: Historical freeze
checks.experiment: Capture two permitted real observations when available; pin older view, allow current state to advance independently; edit CSS and remount.
checks.pass_condition: Pinned view does not advance; labels show capture time/local source and last current check; no backend pause claim.

checks.name: Uncaptured history
checks.experiment: Choose C2-running for a completed call with no prior observation.
checks.pass_condition: Unavailable, not reconstructed from C2-completed and not a hidden fixture.

checks.name: Fresh auth and invalidation
checks.experiment: Offline tests revoke session, change selected tenant, delete source, change report source/run, lose network during capture access.
checks.pass_condition: No historical payload before checks; access lease expires/masks; revoked artifacts purged; no stale private data under error screen.

checks.name: Parser lineage
checks.experiment: Reuse existing TS parsers with captured response set; change one source SHA, recording ID, report run, transcript revision or negative schema fixture.
checks.pass_condition: Invalid set never appears as report.ready; no validator weakening.

checks.name: Reset races
checks.experiment: 20 page generation resets, held late local frame response, mode switches, CSS HMR.
checks.pass_condition: No stale frame takeover, no duplicated subscriptions/polls/writes; live auth preserved only for same session/tenant.

checks.name: Time and motion
checks.experiment: Synthetic regression before/after 60000ms foreground, hidden/visible, offline; local presentation-only timer preview separately.
checks.pass_condition: No fake clock in live bridge; age never advances canonical stage; reduced-motion and 180ms behavior remain separately tested.

checks.name: Audio and reader
checks.experiment: Switch all five sections; open/close source reader; keyboard loop and Escape; test source unavailable and source replacement.
checks.pass_condition: One dock/element per call; no tab-triggered source reload; no autoplay from URL; restore focus or logical fallback.

checks.name: Pixels and reflow
checks.experiment: Actual full-page captures at 320/375/390/768/1024/1440 plus internal-scroll/dialog views where needed; long authorized language content when available.
checks.pass_condition: No horizontal clipping or obscured actions; scrolling allowed; missing real content variants recorded unavailable, covered synthetically in regression only.

checks.name: Bounds and privacy
checks.experiment: Exceed frame/event/body/byte/TTL/command limits; logout/purge; inspect exported receipts and any saved private image permissions.
checks.pass_condition: Bounded memory and explicit eviction; no body truncation; no raw customer text/cookies/audio/IDs in safe export; no cloud artifacts for customer images.

checks.name: Build exclusion and Next isolation
checks.experiment: Compile standalone/static without review flag; assert flag+build fails. Inspect module graph/traced output/routes. Probe inner Next with local canary env variants.
checks.pass_condition: No local adapter/control/store code in release; no /__review handler; dev fragments ignored; inner Next has no upstream rewrites; bridge alone owns fixed VPS egress.

checks.name: Falsification benchmark
checks.experiment: Offline compiled A/B of original bootstrap and proposed canonical route using identical existing synthetic payloads and fixed 100ms GET delays. 20 runs per version at 390 and 1440, same runtime/cache mode.
checks.pass_condition: Record report-validated-to-paint and total navigation latency, request graph/count, transient wrong-view frames, layout shift, audio remounts. Reject extra waterfall or regressions; no invented improvement percentage.
